concerns.text: FR-006 (Runtime Measurement) and its associated success criterion SC-004 enforce a CI runtime limit of 7200 seconds. The original idea does not require any runtime monitoring or CI constraints to answer the research question about a reasoning threshold; this adds engineering scope beyond what is needed for scientific validity.

FR-009 (Memory Usage Logging) and SC-005 impose a CI memory limit of 7 GB. The research question focuses on structural complexity and accuracy thresholds; memory monitoring is not required to address the hypothesis and therefore represents scope over‑reach.
